# **NSBM Green University Undergraduate, Foundation, and Sub-Degree Programme Directory Report**

## **Institutional Portfolio Overview and Coverage**

An audit of the official digital directory and course catalogue of NSBM Green University (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/) identifies **64 undergraduate degree programmes** and **1 overarching Foundation Programme for Bachelor's Degree** (structured across 5 faculty-aligned streams) distributed across four academic faculties: the **Faculty of Computing**, the **Faculty of Business**, the **Faculty of Engineering**, and the **Faculty of Science**1. Because the institution's full undergraduate portfolio exceeds the capacity of a single course-by-course extraction, this report completes the **Foundation Programme for Bachelor's Degree** (all 5 pathways) and the **Faculty of Computing** (all 13 undergraduate degree programmes found in the faculty directory) in full1. In addition, **14 undergraduate degree programmes** from the Faculties of Business, Engineering, and Science for which official course pages were retrieved during cross-faculty verification are documented in Section A5. The remaining **37 undergraduate programmes found** across the Faculties of Business, Engineering, and Science are catalogued in Section C for subsequent research requests1.  
A structural review of the programmes found demonstrates a dual-track delivery framework operating at the university's campus at Mahenwaththa, Pitipana, Homagama3. Internal degree programmes taught and awarded directly by NSBM Green University follow a four-year full-time structure3. Transnational degree programmes taught at NSBM and awarded by international partner institutions—the University of Plymouth (United Kingdom), Victoria University (Australia), Southern Cross University (Australia), and American University (United States)—predominantly follow a three-year full-time structure, with selected partner engineering awards incorporating an additional six-month industrial internship1. Furthermore, the institution does not offer standalone undergraduate diplomas or Higher National Diplomas (HNDs); all diploma-titled courses published on the institutional domain are Postgraduate Diplomas, which are excluded from this undergraduate directory21. Instead, external HNDs, Higher National Diplomas in Engineering (HNDE), and National Diplomas in Technology (NDT) serve as lateral entry routes into Year 2 (Level 5\) or Year 3 (Level 6\) of University of Plymouth Top-Up degree programmes within the Faculties of Engineering and Science7.

## **B. Short Programme Notes and Entry Pathway Analysis**

An analysis of the official NSBM course pages reveals several multi-stage admission mechanisms, stream-specific prerequisite gates, and internal fee or duration discrepancies across domestic and transnational degree tracks2.  
![][image2]

### **Conflicting Fee Schedules and Duration Entries on Official Course Pages**

Several official NSBM course pages display two distinct tuition fee structures on the same URL without specifying whether the discrepancy reflects an upfront annual payment discount, a legacy cohort tariff, or an installment surcharge. Across six internal four-year degrees—*BSc (Hons) in Computer Science* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bachelor-of-science-honours-in-computer-science-bsc-honours-in-computer-science-ugc/), *BSc (Honours) in Software Engineering* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-honours-in-software-engineering/), *BSc (Honours) in Data Science* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-honours-in-data-science/), *BSc (Honours) in Computer Networks* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-honours-in-computer-networks-ugc/), *BM (Honors) in Applied Economics* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bachelor-of-management-honors-in-applied-economics/), and *BMgtHons (International Business)* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bmgthons-international-business/)—one fee block states an annual tuition fee of **700,000 LKR per year** for Years 1 through 4 and a full four-year programme fee of **2,800,000 LKR** (with a 10,000 LKR Registration Fee and 5,000 LKR Library Fee explicitly itemized on the Computer Networks page)13. On the exact same pages, however, a second fee block states that the fee for each semester is **400,000 LKR**13. Two other internal four-year degrees, *BSc in Management Information Systems (Special)* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-in-management-information-systems-special-ugc/) and *BM (Hons) in Accounting and Finance* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bm-hons-in-accounting-and-finance/), publish only the **400,000 LKR per semester** figure3. A parallel discrepancy occurs on the page for the internal *Bachelor of Science of Engineering Honours in Electrical and Electronic Engineering* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-engineering-honours-in-electrical-and-electronic-engineering/), which lists **800,000 LKR per year** across Years 1 to 4 in one section and **450,000 LKR per semester** in another5.  
Within the international partner portfolio, the Victoria University *Bachelor of Information Technology (Major in Cyber Security)* page (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bachelor-of-information-technology-major-in-cyber-security-vu/) contains an internal arithmetic conflict19. Specifically, the page lists **Year 1: 900,000 LKR (450,000 × 2 Installments)**, **Year 2: 650,000 LKR (350,000 × 2 Installments)**, and **Year 3: 650,000 LKR (350,000 × 2 Installments)**, alongside a **10,000 LKR Registration Fee**, a **5,000 LKR Library Fee**, and a **Total 3-Year Full-Time Course Fee of 2,300,000 LKR**19. Two installments of 350,000 LKR equal 700,000 LKR per year rather than 650,000 LKR, and summing 900,000 LKR \+ 700,000 LKR \+ 700,000 LKR yields the published 2,300,000 LKR total, whereas summing the stated annual figures (900,000 \+ 650,000 \+ 650,000 LKR) equals 2,200,000 LKR19. Although students may complete Years 2 and 3 at NSBM or transfer to Victoria University in Melbourne, Australia, only local LKR fees are published on the page19. Similarly, five University of Plymouth Computing degrees (*Computer Science*, *Software Engineering*, *Computer Networks*, *Computer Security*, and *Technology Management*) and the Southern Cross University *Bachelor of Business* publish an explicit front-loaded schedule of **Year 1: 1,200,000 LKR**, **Year 2: 700,000 LKR**, **Year 3: 700,000 LKR**, **Registration Fee: 10,000 LKR**, and **Library Fee: 5,000 LKR** (with a published 3-year total of **2,600,000 LKR** on the Plymouth pages), while also displaying a generic notice referring applicants to contact \+94 11 544 5000 regarding a semester-based flexible course fee structure14. The remaining researched Plymouth pages (*Data Science*, *Artificial Intelligence*, *Marketing Management*, *Civil and Structural Engineering*, *Electronic and Computer Engineering*, *Interior Design*, *Psychology*, and the Top-Up degrees) publish only the flexible fee notice without numerical values6. Additionally, the Plymouth *BSc (Hons) in Data Science* page (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-data-science-plymouth/) states **3 Years (Full time)** in its main header and three-year module syllabus, but retains a single conflicting line stating **Four Years (Full Time)** near the student loan notice40.

### **Stream-Specific Entry Gates, Bridging Courses, and Aptitude Assessments**

Admission into NSBM's foundation and undergraduate programmes is governed by subject-specific secondary school thresholds and conditional testing gates2. At the foundation level (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/foundation-programme-for-bachelors-degree/), all five streams run for one year full-time at a fee of 800,000 LKR, but GCE O/L subject requirements tighten across technical tracks2. The *Business, Computing, and Design* foundation streams require at least 6 passes at local GCE O/L (with 3 credit passes referenced on partner degree progression pages) or 5 passes including English and Mathematics with 3 Credit (C) passes at Cambridge or Edexcel O/L2. The *Science* foundation stream requires at least Credit (C) passes in Science, Mathematics, and English at local GCE O/L, or Credit (C) passes in Human Biology/Biology, Chemistry, and Physics/Mathematics at Edexcel or Cambridge O/L2. The *Engineering* foundation stream enforces the highest threshold, requiring 6 Credit (C) passes including Mathematics, Science, and English at either local GCE O/L or Cambridge/Edexcel O/L2. Furthermore, completion of the NSBM Foundation Programme only unlocks progression to University of Plymouth Engineering degrees (*BEng (Hons) Civil and Structural Engineering* and *BEng (Hons) Electronic and Computer Engineering*) if the candidate also holds at least Credit (C) passes in Mathematics and Science at GCE O/L18.  
At the undergraduate degree level, internal NSBM Computing programmes (*BSc (Hons) in Computer Science*, *BSc (Honours) in Software Engineering*, *BSc (Honours) in Data Science*, *BSc (Honours) in Computer Networks*, and *BSc in Management Information Systems (Special)*) grant direct Option 1 / Option A entry to applicants with 3 Simple passes (S) in the Physical Science or Engineering Technology stream in one GCE A/L sitting3. Applicants entering from any other GCE A/L stream must hold a mandatory **Credit pass (C) in Mathematics at GCE O/L** and complete an approved **bridging programme**3. Even where an applicant qualifies for a bridging exemption—such as holding a Simple pass (S) in Information & Communication Technology at GCE A/L for *BSc in Management Information Systems (Special)* or *BSc (Honours) in Computer Networks*—the Credit pass (C) in GCE O/L Mathematics and a Simple pass (S) in GCE O/L English or GCE A/L General English remain strictly compulsory3. Similarly, within the Faculty of Business, *BM (Hons) in Accounting and Finance* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bm-hons-in-accounting-and-finance/) allows direct Option A entry with 3 Simple passes (S) in the Commerce stream including Accounting as a main subject, whereas non-Commerce A/L applicants entering under Option B must hold Credit passes (C) in both Mathematics and Business & Accounting Studies at GCE O/L9. For *BSc in Business Management (Logistics Management) (Special)* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-in-business-management-logistics-management-special/), Option A requires 3 Simple passes (S) in the Commerce stream, while Option B accepts 3 Simple passes (S) in any stream provided Economics is a main A/L subject and the candidate holds a Simple pass (S) in GCE O/L Mathematics45.  
Within the University of Plymouth undergraduate portfolio, admission testing varies by technical specialization. Four Plymouth computing programmes—*BSc (Hons) Software Engineering*, *BSc (Hons) Computer Networks*, *BSc (Hons) Computer Security*, and *BSc (Hons) Technology Management*—accept 3 passes in a single sitting at GCE A/L in any core subject stream (excluding London AS Level examinations, which are explicitly not recognized) or an approved foundation programme, combined with GCE O/L passes in Mathematics and English and a potential preliminary interview14. By contrast, Plymouth's *BSc (Hons) Computer Science* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-computer-science/), *BSc (Hons) in Data Science* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-data-science-plymouth/), and *BSc (Hons) Artificial Intelligence* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-artificial-intelligence-plymouth-university-uk/) restrict direct A/L entry to the **Physical Science and Biological Science streams**; applicants from non-STEM A/L streams or Foundation routes must pass a mandatory **selection test / placement test** prior to Plymouth registration20. For creative and behavioural disciplines, *BA (Hons) in Interior Design* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/ba-hons-in-interior-design/) requires applicants who did not pass or sit for GCE O/L Arts to pass an internal **Portfolio Test** alongside IELTS 6.0 or equivalent34, while *BSc (Hons) Psychology* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-honours-psychology/) requires IELTS 6.0 or equivalent, which may be fulfilled via the **NSBM English Language Assessment**6.

### **Sub-Degree Lateral Entry Routes and Top-Up Degree Mechanics**

Although NSBM Green University does not offer standalone undergraduate diplomas or HNDs in its faculty directories, sub-degree qualifications operate as structured entry mechanisms across two distinct tiers7. First, on the Victoria University *Bachelor of Information Technology (Major in Cyber Security)* page (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bachelor-of-information-technology-major-in-cyber-security-vu/), an **NSBM Certificate Programme** is specified as an entry bridge for applicants who obtained only 2 unit passes at Sri Lankan GCE A/L, enabling them to qualify for Year 1 degree admission19. Second, in the Faculty of Engineering, external sub-degree qualifications unlock lateral entry into University of Plymouth Top-Up degrees7. For the *BSc (Hons) Quantity Surveying Top-Up Degree* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-quantity-surveying-top-up-degree/), applicants holding a Pearson BTEC HND with an Overall Pass, a College of Estate Management Diploma in Surveying Studies with 60% or higher, an HND at NVQ Level 5, or an IET qualification (preferably with 6 months of industry experience) enter at **Year 2 (Level 5\)**, whereas applicants holding a Pearson BTEC HND with an Overall Merit or Distinction, an HNDE or NDES with an Overall Merit or above, an HND from IQSSL with an Overall GPA of 3.0 or above, or IQSSL Levels 1, 2, and 3 with an Overall Merit or GPA of 3.0 or above (preferably with 1 year of industry experience) enter directly into **Year 3 (Level 6 / Final Year)**7. For the part-time *BEng (Hons) Electrical, Electronic and Communication Engineering Top-Up Degree* (https\://www\.nsbm.ac.lk/course/beng-hons-electrical-electronic-and-communication-engineering-top-up-degree/), direct lateral entry into Level 6 (120 credits over two semesters) requires completion of an HND, HNDE, or NDT in a relevant engineering discipline, two years of industrial experience, an **English Proficiency Test** conducted by NSBM Green University, and a formal admission **interview**8.
